features.note: All 37 views preserve the 60x45 grammar: front threshold with marquee, public band, center spine, 4+4 room masses, rear service strip; blockout-vs-final strip confirms massing unchanged since L2 with only roof furniture added (14 RTUs + chips).

es-arch labels 1L/2M/3M/4S/5L/6M/7M/8S over visibly different footprints; sala3-arch shows tiers, screen, aisle LEDs, speakers; weakness: in neutral-arch-rooffoff the room interiors read as near-black voids and the M4 fill lift does not make stepped tiers discernible, family recognition there rests on footprint alone.

Exterior entry (yellow mat, person, posters, Cinemex marquee) -> lobby ticket rail -> concession counter with menu boards and POS -> kitchen workline with hood -> dressed checkpoint (counter caps, staff proxy in lane, scanner block) -> ticketed corridor with room numbers and wayfinding reads continuously; checkpoint scanner emissive screen is barely legible.

net-eng shows 14 TC300 labels, UC-A..D, UG67 with dual antennas and propagation rings, schematic board, and the single blue IP chain ROUTER/FIREWALL->INTERNET->NIAGARA->PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE; faults are proportionate (TC300=1 evento, UC100-B=4, internet=14 with grayed chain) with no shortcut edge; t0/t30 packet motion confirmed by pixel diff on all four pairs.

net-arch (opaque, layers off) vs net-eng (translucent, buses/links) frame the same coherent building; hot/fault states recolor only the owning zone+chip; M3 verified: no hovering spine duct in the roof-off shot; chips obey the exterior-only visibility contract in both modes (present in 10 exterior views incl. top, absent in all 9 interior views and both ug67 shots).

important_features.note: 1.8 m person at entry and corridor, staff proxy at checkpoint lane, real-scale RTUs/TC300/UC/UG67; chips read as badge-scale billboards, not inflated geometry.

Bright lobby/menus -> warm dim corridor -> low-emission salas holds; lightsoff trio proves emission channels (EXIT/aisle/screen persist); shortfall: roof-off fill lift leaves auditorium interiors near-black so tiers do not read.

Mains/branches strapped with yellow accents, RTUs curb-seated above their zones with supply drops, spine assembly follows the roof toggle, network media terminate on devices; hit: the 'light galvanized' M1 read only survives on sun-lit tops - vertical duct faces sample charcoal (RGB 38,41,43).

headroom_recommendation: Accept and ship: a solid 0.80 with all criticals clear. Remaining headroom (~+0.04) is concentrated in two low-risk, geometry-free tweaks: lift the shaded-face response of the galvanized ducts (metalness/env fill) and add a top-preset size floor for the chips plus a touch more roof-off floor fill. Not worth another full gated round unless the client calls out the roof ducts.
defects: Galvanized duct vertical faces read charcoal, not light metal: roofservice-arch samples RGB(38,41,43) and RGB(35,36,37) on the main and branch drop, technical-arch samples RGB(34,28,22); only sun-lit top faces read galvanized (RGB 218,206,184). This is the declared M1 risk landing on the opposite (charcoal) pole.
Top-preset chips are countable (14) but the zone-name line is illegible at native 2880x2160 (badge ~65 px wide, name row blurred); temperature digits are borderline in top-arch and the top-hot pair.

neutral-arch-rooffoff: all eight auditorium interiors render as near-black voids; no stepped seating tier edges are discernible despite the M4 fill lift (crops 1150-2300 x 850-1500 confirm flat black floors).
Checkpoint scanner/POS emissive screen is a ~10 px flat light-blue face on a small cube; it does not read as a lit screen at the checkpoint preset.
In roof-off exterior views the 14 temperature chips remain visible while their owning RTUs are hidden with the roof layer, so the badges float with no anchor object beneath them.
corrections: Raise the shaded-face response of the galvanized duct material (reduce metalness toward 0.4-0.6 or add hemisphere/env fill) until vertical faces of mains and branches sample at least RGB(120,125,130) in roofservice-arch while tops stay under RGB(235).
Add a distance-scaled minimum sprite size for the top preset so the chip zone-name line resolves at >=11 px cap height at 2880 px width, preserving 14-chip countability.
Increase roof-off fill on auditorium floors/tiers (or lighten the tier material one step) until step edges read in at least the three fully visible far rooms of neutral-arch-rooffoff.
Enlarge the checkpoint scanner/POS screen face and give it a small emissive bloom so it reads as a screen from the checkpoint preset.
Tie chip visibility (or re-anchor chips to zone centroids at plate height) to the roof layer so no unanchored badges float when the owning units are hidden.
